root_motivation: Enforce the cloudbuild-only rule in a single canonical primitive that all crate-rebuild consumers (rollout, agorabus freshness loop, headway-verify) can delegate to, instead of re-litigating the rule per caller and risking local cargo invocations.
user_persona: Joe Yen, on wintermute laptop, running automated rebuild loops (rollout, agorabus reload --build, headway-verify) that need to recompile Rust crates via Hetzner cloudbuild, never locally.

acceptance_criteria.description: headway build <crate-dir> --dry-run --format json prints a BuildPlan plus the exact cloudbuild.sh build <name> command line that would run, mutates nothing, and exits 0. Default posture is dry-run.

With --no-dry-run (apply), build invokes cloudbuild.sh build <name> as a subprocess and returns a BuildVerdict whose cloudbuild_status reflects the subprocess outcome. Tested with a stub cloudbuild script via HEADWAY_CLOUDBUILD pointing at a fixture.

There is no code path that runs cargo build/cargo install locally. A grep in the test suite asserts the crate contains no local-cargo invocation in the build path; the only compiler invocation is via the cloudbuild subprocess.

When the configured cloudbuild script is absent or exits with the unreachable code, build returns status: cloudbuild-unreachable, emits a structured error to stderr, and exits non-zero — never silently builds local.
When installed_version == source_head (already fresh), build returns status: no-op-fresh without invoking cloudbuild, unless --no-require-fresh is passed.
BuildVerdict records version_before and version_after; on a successful build against a fixture they differ, on a no-op they are equal.
headway --version and headway build --help work on the freshly-built binary; cargo test is green and clippy produces no new warnings over the repo baseline.

scope: Library: build(plan, cfg) -> BuildVerdict that shells out to cloudbuild.sh
BuildPlan struct: crate_dir, crate_name, source_head, installed_version
BuildVerdict struct: crate_name, artifact_path, version_before, version_after, cloudbuild_status, elapsed_ms, status
Status enum: built | no-op-fresh | cloudbuild-unreachable | build-failed
HEADWAY_CLOUDBUILD env var to override cloudbuild.sh path
Hard guard: no local cargo code path, ever
non_goals: Does not implement cloudbuild.sh itself — only wraps it as a subprocess
Does not manage Hetzner server lifecycle (up/down) — that is cloudbuild.sh's domain
Does not build multiple crates in parallel (fleet mode) — that is a headway-fleet follow-on PRD
Does not cache or deduplicate builds beyond the no-op-fresh freshness check
Does not fall back to local cargo under any circumstance — cloudbuild-unreachable is always the fallback status

additional.sigpipe_reset: sigpipe::reset() must be the first line of main() per standing SIGPIPE-panic lesson

five_whys_trace.q: Why does headway need to exist at all?
five_whys_trace.a: rollout/src/fleet.rs:71 hardcodes 'cargo build --release' as the default build_cmd — a local compile — violating the standing cloudbuild-only rule.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can't each caller just call cloudbuild.sh directly?
five_whys_trace.a: The cloudbuild path was intended but never wired: rollout/src/warmswap.rs:630 has an ignored placeholder test with 'Run manually with:…'. Without a canonical primitive, every caller re-litigates and often misses the wiring.

five_whys_trace.q: Why is the missing wiring a blocker right now?
five_whys_trace.a: The recurring self-review item 'agorabus 3d behind source; needs cloudbuild + reload --apply' is unactionable because no callable primitive wraps the cloudbuild build step for the freshness loop.

five_whys_trace.q: Why not just fix rollout in place rather than adding a new crate?
five_whys_trace.a: A point-fix to rollout enforces the rule in one caller only; a shared primitive enforces it everywhere in one place and makes cloudbuild-unreachable the hard-coded fallback rather than an afterthought.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What rust_edition to use — PRD says MSRV 1.85 but doesn't name edition?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Using edition 2021 (compatible with MSRV 1.85; edition 2024 requires rustc 1.85+ but let_chains not needed here).

ambiguities_resolved.question: Does --dry-run default mean the CLI argument needs to be explicit or is it the absence of --no-dry-run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: Default posture is dry-run; --no-dry-run flag enables apply mode. Matches agorabus reload --require-fresh precedent described in PRD.
